summary: Strive, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a $500 million offering of 5,000,000 shares of 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock, each with a $100 stated amount and liquidation preference, implying $100 per share. Dividends accrue cumulatively at 15% annually, with an 18-month dividend reserve of $22.50 per share funded from cash and securities. Strive applied to list the SATS Stock on Nasdaq under the symbol SATS. Full redemption is permitted if outstanding shares fall below 25% of the original issuance, and holders receive a fundamental-change repurchase right at stated amount plus accrued dividends. This is a routine preferred equity capital raise, not a special situation; watch dividend coverage, reserve adequacy, and the contemplated at-the-market overhang.
